info.title: 0x API
info.description: This is the official API reference for the latest 0x API (v2).

get.description: Get the indicative price for a swap using Allowance Holder to set allowances

parameters.description: Visit dashboard.0x.org to get your API Key
parameters.name: 0x-api-key

parameters.description: API version
parameters.name: 0x-version
chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID. See [here](https://docs.0x.org/docs/introduction/supported-chains) for the list of supported chains

parameters.name: buyToken
parameters.description: The contract address of the token to buy

parameters.name: sellToken
parameters.description: The contract address of the token to sell

parameters.name: sellAmount
parameters.description: The amount of `sellToken` in `sellToken` base units to sell. Exactly one of `sellAmount` or `buyAmount` must be provided — specifying both will result in an error.

parameters.name: buyAmount
parameters.description: The amount of `buyToken` in `buyToken` base units to buy. Exactly one of `sellAmount` or `buyAmount` must be provided — specifying both will result in an error.

parameters.name: taker
parameters.description: The address which holds the `sellToken` balance and has the allowance set for the swap

parameters.name: txOrigin
parameters.description: The address of the external account that started the transaction. This is only needed if `taker` is a smart contract.

parameters.name: recipient
parameters.description: The address to receive the `buyToken`. If not provided, defaults to the taker address. Not supported for wrap/unwrap operations.

parameters.name: swapFeeRecipient
parameters.description: The wallet address to receive the specified trading fees (supports single or multiple comma-separated values). You must also specify `swapFeeBps` or `swapFeePpm` in the request to use this feature. When multiple values are provided, must match the length of `swapFeeBps` or `swapFeePpm`.

parameters.name: swapFeeBps
parameters.description: The amount in Bps of the `swapFeeToken` to charge and deliver to the `swapFeeRecipient` (supports single or multiple comma-separated values). You must also specify the `swapFeeRecipient` in the request to use this feature. For security, this field has a default limit of 1000 Bps. If your application requires a higher value, please reach out to us.

parameters.name: swapFeePpm
parameters.description: The amount in parts-per-million (PPM) of the `swapFeeToken` to charge and deliver to the `swapFeeRecipient` (supports single or multiple comma-separated values). Mutually exclusive with `swapFeeBps`. You must also specify the `swapFeeRecipient` in the request to use this feature. Each value must be an integer from 0 to 1000000. For security, this field has a default limit of 100000 PPM. If your application requires a higher value, please reach out to us. e.g. 5000 PPM = 50 BPS = 0.5%.

parameters.name: swapFeeToken
parameters.description: The contract address of the token to receive trading fees in (supports single or multiple comma-separated values). Each token must be set to the value of either the `buyToken` or the `sellToken`. If omitted, the fee token will be determined by 0x with preference to stablecoins and highly liquid assets. You must also specify the `swapFeeRecipient` and either `swapFeeBps` or `swapFeePpm` to charge integrator fees. When multiple values are provided, must match the length of `swapFeeBps` or `swapFeePpm`.

parameters.name: tradeSurplusRecipient
parameters.description: The address to receive any trade surplus. If specified, this address will receive trade surplus when applicable. Otherwise, the taker will receive the surplus. This feature is only available to selected integrators on a custom pricing plan. In other cases, the surplus will be collected by 0x. For assistance with a custom plan, please contact support.

parameters.name: tradeSurplusMaxBps
parameters.description: The maximum trade surplus (positive slippage) that can be collected in Bps of the buy amount. If not provided, defaults to 10000 (100%). Must be used together with `tradeSurplusRecipient`. Mutually exclusive with `tradeSurplusMaxPpm`.

parameters.name: tradeSurplusMaxPpm
parameters.description: The maximum trade surplus (positive slippage) that can be collected in parts-per-million (PPM) of the buy amount. Mutually exclusive with `tradeSurplusMaxBps`. If not provided, defaults to 1000000 (100%). Must be used together with `tradeSurplusRecipient`. e.g. 5000 PPM = 50 BPS = 0.5%.

parameters.name: gasPrice
parameters.description: The target gas price (in wei) for the swap transaction. If not provided, the default value is based on the 0x gas price oracle

parameters.name: slippageBps
parameters.description: The maximum acceptable slippage of the `buyToken` in Bps. If this parameter is set to 0, no slippage will be tolerated. If not provided, the default slippage tolerance is 100Bps. Deprecated: use `slippagePpm` instead. `slippageBps` accepts only whole numbers.

parameters.name: slippagePpm
parameters.description: The maximum acceptable slippage of the `buyToken` in parts-per-million (PPM). Mutually exclusive with `slippageBps`. e.g. 3000 PPM = 30 BPS = 0.30%.

parameters.name: excludedSources
parameters.description: Liquidity sources e.g. Uniswap_V3, SushiSwap, 0x_RFQ to exclude from the provided quote. See https://api.0x.org/sources?chainId=<chain_id> with the desired chain's ID for a full list of sources. Separate multiple sources with a comma

parameters.name: sellEntireBalance
parameters.description: If set to `true`, the taker's entire `sellToken` balance will be sold during trade execution. The `sellAmount` should be the maximum estimated value, as close as possible to the actual taker's balance to ensure the best routing. Selling more than the `sellAmount` may cause the trade to revert. This feature is designed for cases where the precise sell amount is determined during execution. Learn more [here](https://docs.0x.org/docs/0x-swap-api/additional-topics/sell-entire-balance).

parameters.name: wrapUnwrapMode
parameters.description: Controls how native wrap/unwrap trades are executed. `direct` calls the wrapped-native token contract directly. `settler` routes wrap/unwrap through Settler or Allowance Holder for compatibility. Ignored for non-wrap/unwrap swaps. If omitted, `direct` mode is used.

allowanceTarget.description: The target contract address for which the `taker` needs to have an allowance in order to be able to complete the swap. For swaps with the native asset (ie "ETH" or "BNB") as the `sellToken`, wrapping the native asset (i.e. "ETH" to "WETH") or unwrapping, no allowance is needed

blockNumber.description: The block number at which the liquidity sources were sampled to generate the quote. This indicates the freshness of the quote

buyAmount.description: The amount of `buyToken` (in `buyToken` units) that will be bought in the swap

buyToken.description: The contract address of the token to buy in the swap

amount.description: The amount of token charged as the integrator fee

token.description: The address of the token charged as the integrator fee

integratorFee.description: The specified fee to charge and deliver to the `swapFeeRecipient`.

zeroExFee.description: The fee charged by 0x for the trade.

token.description: The address of the token charged as the gas fee

gasFee.description: The gas fee to be used in submitting the transaction.

fees.description: Fees to be deducted in this transaction. It contains the `integratorFee`, `zeroExFee` and `gasFee`

spender.description: The address to set the allowance on

allowance.description: Details of allowances that the `taker` must set for in order to execute the swap successfully. Null if no allowance is required

actual.description: The current balance of the `sellToken` in the `taker` address

expected.description: The balance of the `sellToken` required for the swap to execute successfully

balance.description: Details of balance of the `sellToken` that the `taker` must hold. Null if the `taker` has sufficient balance

simulationIncomplete.description: This is set to `true` when 0x cannot validate the transaction. This happens when the `taker` has an insufficient balance of the `sellToken` and 0x is unable to peform ehanced quote validation with the low balance. Note that this does not necessarily mean that the trade will revert

issues.description: An object containing potential issues discovered during 0x validation that can prevent the swap from being executed successfully by the `taker`

spender.description: The address to set the allowance on

allowance.description: Details of allowances that the `taker` must set for in order to execute the swap successfully. Null if no allowance is required

actual.description: The current balance of the `sellToken` in the `taker` address

expected.description: The balance of the `sellToken` required for the swap to execute successfully

balance.description: Details of balance of the `sellToken` that the `taker` must hold. Null if the `taker` has sufficient balance

simulationIncomplete.description: This is set to `true` when 0x cannot validate the transaction. This happens when the `taker` has an insufficient balance of the `sellToken` and 0x is unable to peform ehanced quote validation with the low balance. Note that this does not necessarily mean that the trade will revert

invalidSourcesPassed.description: A list of invalid sources present in `excludedSources` request. See `https://api.0x.org/sources?chainId=` with the desired chain's ID for the list of valid sources

issues.description: An object containing potential issues discovered during 0x validation that can prevent the swap from being executed successfully by the `taker`

liquidityAvailable.description: This validates the availability of liquidity for the quote requested. The rest of the fields will only be returned if `true`

sellToken.description: Swap-related metadata for the sell token

tokenMetadata.description: Swap-related metadata for the buy and sell token in the swap

totalNetworkFee.description: The estimated total network cost of the swap: the expected gas * `gasPrice`, plus the L1 data cost on chains that have one. `gas` is the transaction gas limit and can exceed the expected gas when the transaction carries a fallback route, so this can be less than `gas` * `gasPrice`.

zid.description: The unique ZeroEx identifier of the request

to.description: The address of the target contract to send call `data` to. Do NOT use this field when setting token allowances — doing so can result in lost funds. Always use `issues.allowance.spender` or `allowanceTarget` for setting allowances.

data.description: The calldata containing transaction execution details to be sent to the `to` address

gas.description: The estimated gas limit that should be used to send the transaction to guarantee settlement

gasPrice.description: The gas price (in wei) that should be used to send the transaction

value.description: The amount of ether (in wei) that should be sent with the transaction

transaction.description: This object contains the details required to submit the transaction
